about: Starting points for a new Godot project (crates/amal-core/src/godot.rs). A template with a repo is fetched once - a shallow sparse clone of only its folder - into <home>/cache/godot-templates and reused; one without a repo is written by AMAL. Add any git repository + folder that holds a project.godot.

templates.name: Empty 3D
templates.about: a new 3D game: main scene with camera, sun, sky light and a floor

templates.name: Empty 2D
templates.about: a new 2D game: main scene with a camera

templates.name: Flappy Bird (2D)
templates.about: 2D one-button flyer: tap, click or Space to flap through gaps in pipes, score, game over and play again - AMAL's own starter, played by its check

templates.name: Snake (2D)
templates.about: 2D snake on a grid: arrow keys, WASD or a swipe to steer, food to grow, walls and tail end it - AMAL's own starter, played by its check

templates.name: Breakout (2D)
templates.about: 2D brick breaker: a paddle moved by mouse, finger, pen or keys, a ball, rows of bricks, lives and score - AMAL's own starter, played by its check

templates.name: Squash the Creeps (3D)
templates.about: 3D character that moves and jumps on enemies, score, mobs spawning - Godot's first-3D-game tutorial, finished

templates.name: Platformer 3D
templates.about: 3D platformer: character controller, coins, enemies, moving platforms

templates.name: Truck Town
templates.about: 3D vehicles with physics in a small town

templates.name: Dodge the Creeps (2D)
templates.about: 2D top-down: player dodges enemies, score, game over - Godot's first-2D-game tutorial, finished

templates.name: Platformer 2D
templates.about: 2D side-scrolling platformer: player, enemies, coins, tiles

templates.name: Pong (2D)
templates.about: 2D pong: two paddles, a ball that bounces, score - a one-screen arcade game to build on (breakout, air hockey)

templates.name: Top-down RPG (2D)
templates.about: 2D top-down role-playing game: a grid map, a player that walks, characters to talk to, a turn-based combat screen

templates.name: Third-person character (3D)
templates.about: 3D third-person character: walk, run and jump in a small level with a following camera

templates.name: Souls-like action (3D)
templates.about: 3D third-person melee action RPG (souls-like, action adventure, dungeon crawler, sword fighting, boss fight): lock-on, dodge roll, weapons and shields, enemies, ladders, pickups - a modular rig that takes any humanoid model with a standard Godot/Unity/Mixamo skeleton and plays the whole animation library on it. Code Unlicense, assets CC0 (Cat's Godot 4 Modular Souls-like Template)

templates.name: Voxel world (3D)
templates.about: 3D voxel world in blocks you break and place, generated as you walk, first person - a block-building game to build on
